svg.text: Round-two prototype · ESP32 38-pin + 5 V dual relay + 2 pumps · build exactly as drawn (source: JalSense Round Two Kit) · 5.5 k resistors · relay: jumper ON, VCC on 5 V
+3V3 rail link (ESP32 3V3 pin feeds both +3V3 rails)
BREADBOARD RAILS: red = +5V blue = GND second rail = +3V3 gold dot = pin / junction ground symbol = tie to the GND rail
dissolved salts in the inlet water
detects cloudy water - use the A pin
stainless probe tip goes in the tank
REMOVE THIS WIRE WHEN USB IS PLUGGED IN
OPTIONAL LOCK JUMPER: wire D23 to GND = LOCK MODE (always RO)
1 Relay: KEEP the JD-VCC <-> VCC jumper ON. Relay VCC = +5V (not 3V3).
2 Laptop USB plugged in? Unplug the 5V-rail -> ESP32 5V wire.
3 Turbidity: use the A (analog) pin, not D.
4 Flow: blow on the wheel; GPIO27 must swing 0 - 3.3 V.
5 Fit the 470 uF cap across 5V and GND near the relay.
6 Keep the breadboard above the water line (drip tray below).
7 Resistors: all six are 5.5 k (R1 R2 R3 R4a R4b R5).
Dividers keep the same ratio (/2 and x2/3): no code change.
Pumps: relay COM1 / COM2 = +5V, NO1 -> pump A (+), NO2 -> pump B (+), both pump (-) to GND. Relay inputs are active-LOW (LOW = pump ON). Both pumps stay OFF at power-up.
